newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MILAN AND NAPOLI HANDED HEAVY FINES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MILAN AND NAPOLI HANDED HEAVY FINES.

text.p: Italian champions AC Milan and serie A rivals Napoli were given heavy fines on Wednesday after crowd trouble at recent matches.

Milan were fined 50 million lire ($30,000) after irate supporters threw smoke bombs, flares, bottles and fruit onto the pitch after arch-rivals Inter took a 3-0 lead at the San Siro last Sunday. Inter won 3-1.
Inter were fined four million lire ($2,400) after their fans' threw fruit onto the pitch.
Napoli were fined 25 million lire ($15,000) after various objects were thrown from the crowd at a linesman who was hit by a coin during their home match against Cagliari.
